title: The Rozeal band with Roy Palmer and Joe Johnson
summary: Foster's first small band, with guitarists who became trombone and trumpet players.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: No. We learned string bass, any string bass player, any kind of string bass can play a little bit guitar. And any good guitar player can play string bass. Because you've got four strings on there, it's the same as string bass. Then we formed a little band around in New Orleans called the Rozeal's Band. And Roy Palmer-

See Roy Palmer was first a guitar player where we had a little three piece band, see. Then we converted Roy to trumpet player, see. And we had Joe Johnson on guitar. My brother had an E flat trumpet and trumpet players used to use an E flat trumpet around and brass bands. So Joe kept a fool with his E flat trumpet and learned how to play trumpet. And he had a guy that called the trumpet player, Ovit, Ovit Jackson, that's really Ovit, you know that's French, you know that. See he didn't make it on trumpet, so Roy switched the trombone and Joe went to trumpet. And then both of them tried to be very good, see. Very good.
And Joe Johnson, the trumpet player, had been playing guitar?
Yeah I knew that Roy had played a different instrument.
